-- 1. Database dan sumber data

USE synapseprojek;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.symmetric_keys
    WHERE name = N'##MS_DatabaseMasterKey##'
)
    CREATE MASTER KEY;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.database_scoped_credentials
    WHERE name = N'syn_asprak_identity'
)
    CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL syn_asprak_identity
    WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.external_data_sources
    WHERE name = N'ds_datacuaca_curated'
)
    CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ds_datacuaca_curated
    WITH (
        LOCATION = 'https://adls1tcba.dfs.core.windows.net/curated',
        CREDENTIAL = syn_asprak_identity
    );
GO

SELECT TOP (10) *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'pertemuan8/C_delta_kota_bulan',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'ds_datacuaca_curated',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS r;
GO

-- 2. View polusi dan cuaca

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_polusi_cuaca AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'pertemuan8/C_delta_kota_bulan',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'ds_datacuaca_curated',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
)
WITH (
    kota                 VARCHAR(20),
    tanggal              DATE,
    waktu                DATETIME2,
    jam                  INT,
    bulan                VARCHAR(7),
    pm10_ug_m3           FLOAT,
    pm2_5_ug_m3          FLOAT,
    no2_ug_m3            FLOAT,
    so2_ug_m3            FLOAT,
    o3_ug_m3             FLOAT,
    co_ug_m3             FLOAT,
    temperature_2m       FLOAT,
    relative_humidity_2m FLOAT,
    precipitation        FLOAT,
    wind_speed_10m       FLOAT,
    kategori_pm25        VARCHAR(30)
) AS r;
GO

SELECT name FROM sys.views;

SELECT TOP (10) * FROM dbo.vw_polusi_cuaca;
GO

-- 3. View koordinat kota

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_kota AS
SELECT *
FROM (VALUES
    ('bandung',   'Bandung',   -6.9175, 107.6191),
    ('denpasar',  'Denpasar',  -8.6705, 115.2126),
    ('jakarta',   'Jakarta',   -6.2088, 106.8456),
    ('semarang',  'Semarang',  -6.9667, 110.4167),
    ('surabaya',  'Surabaya',  -7.2575, 112.7521),
    ('surakarta', 'Surakarta', -7.5755, 110.8243)
) AS k(kota, nama_kota, latitude, longitude);
GO

SELECT * FROM dbo.vw_kota;
GO

-- 4. Uji partition pruning

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_baris
FROM dbo.vw_polusi_cuaca;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS baris_jakarta_maret
FROM dbo.vw_polusi_cuaca
WHERE kota = 'jakarta'
  AND tanggal BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31';
